> Therefore, the pragmatic solution to this problem is to change the upgrade model snapshot endpoint so that it only returns to caller once the local task exists as well as the persistent task. This will entail polling periodically from the master for the existence of the local task on the assigned node until it exists.

This could take a long time and possibly require an autoscaling event. I am not 100% sure this is the way.

Yes, good point.  But then the only way would seem to be to introduce a new endpoint to get model snapshot upgrade stats.  Then the UI would poll that instead of the tasks API.  I guess we could add that for 7.17.

issue.body:
**Kibana version:** 7.16.0

**Elasticsearch version:** 7.16.0

**Server OS version:** Any

**Browser version:** Any

**Browser OS version:** Any

**Original install method (e.g. download page, yum, from source, etc.):** Any

**Describe the bug:**

While studying the upgrade assistant code to work out why ML model snapshot upgrades are reported as failing when they really succeed I noticed another bug.  The affected line is: https://github.com/elastic/kibana/blob/8a4985946199161ce3d1967585506cd9e6695a02/x-pack/plugins/upgrade_assistant/server/routes/ml_snapshots.ts#L225

It should be joining together all the elements of the array except the last one using `-` as the separator.  So it should use `slice(0, -1)` instead of `slice(0, 1)`.  This difference only causes a problem if the `job_id` contains hyphens, which is why it hasn't been found to cause a problem in testing so far.

**Steps to reproduce:**

The complicated way to reproduce is:

1. Restore a cluster snapshot into Elasticsearch that contains ML model snapshots that date back to 6.3 or earlier for jobs that have a hyphen in their name - @wwang500 might be able to help with this
2. Look in the 7.16 upgrade assistant and find the deprecation info relating to one of these ML model snapshots
3. Click "Fix" and choose to upgrade it
4. The upgrade will fail because the task ID isn't accurately deciphered back to the job ID and snapshot ID

Unfortunately we've found the upgrade is reported as failing even for jobs without hyphens in the name.  Also, this is a very complex test procedure.

Simpler suggestion:

Extract the code from lines 219-225 into a separate function and write some unit tests for that function: https://github.com/elastic/kibana/blob/8a4985946199161ce3d1967585506cd9e6695a02/x-pack/plugins/upgrade_assistant/server/routes/ml_snapshots.ts#L219-L225

The key piece of knowledge is that job ID can contain hyphens while snapshot ID cannot.

issue.title: [ML] Model snapshot upgrade processes need better cleanup/cancellation functionality

labels.name: Team:ML
labels.description: Meta label for the ML team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
While working on #81519 I noticed a few things about model snapshot upgrades related to cancellation and cleanup:

1. If a model snapshot upgrade persistent task gets cancelled then we don't explicitly kill the associated `autodetect` process.  That process will _probably_ exit pretty soon when its named pipes disconnect from the JVM, but there's no guarantee.  Cancelling the persistent task should explicitly kill the native process.
2. Deleting a job should cancel any model snapshot upgrade tasks for that job before it tries to delete other data.
3. If errors occur in the node operation of a model snapshot upgrade then they shouldn't be logged as errors or generate audit messages if the persistent task has been cancelled.  We've seen with other types of persistent task that these spurious errors can cause noise, confusion and unnecessary support cases, so we should take steps to silence them.
4. I couldn't see how model snapshot upgrade tasks that get set to `failed` ever get removed from cluster state.  Although they'll do nothing, they cause clutter in the cluster state.  This could get bad if some other problem causes a user to repeatedly try upgrading model snapshots and all fail to upgrade for some reason.  For other persistent tasks we have the idiom that force-closing or force-stopping them removes the persistent task from cluster state.  We need _something_ to eventually remove failed model snapshot upgrades from cluster state.

issue.body:
Previously the ML model snapshot upgrade endpoint did not
provide a way to reliably monitor progress. This could lead
to the upgrade assistant UI thinking that a model snapshot
upgrade had finished when it actually hadn't.

This change adds a new "stats" API that allows external
interested parties to find out the status of each model
snapshot upgrade and which node (if any) each is running on.

Fixes #81519

Docs preview: https://elasticsearch_81641.docs-preview.app.elstc.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/master/ml-get-job-model-snapshot-upgrade-stats.html
